content.text:
This is one axial slice of a T2-weighted fat-suppressed MRI (radiological convention: patient right on image left, anterior at top). It contains a fibrous soft-tissue tumor.

The left panel is the clean image; the right panel shows numbered marks. Choose the ONE mark that lies inside the tumor, as close to its centre as possible. End your reply with a final line exactly: ANSWER: <mark number>

The tumor is the large bright, heterogeneous mass in the right (image-left) posterior-medial thigh, next to the femur. It spans roughly x 195–375 and y 325–540 in the left panel. In the right panel the offset is about +784 px, so the mass covers about x 980–1160.

Candidate marks near the mass:
- 1344 at (1067, 343) sits at the upper edge of the mass.
- 1442 at (956, 419) is outside the mass, at its left edge.
- 1441 at (1120, 448) is near the medial border, close to the dark bone cortex.
- 1190 at (1032, 466) is well inside the mass, near its center.

Mark 1190 is the best choice.

ANSWER: 1190
